# Every symbol the shared library exports: the C ABI's functions and
# nothing else (tests/exported_symbols.rs). Adding a line is an ABI change:
# the header (include/, regenerated by cbindgen) and README.md's list change
# with it.
aprv_string_free
aprv_verifier_free
aprv_verifier_new
aprv_verify_receipt
aprv_verify_receipt_bytes
aprv_verify_receipt_endpoint
aprv_verify_receipt_endpoint_bytes
aprv_verify_signed_data
aprv_verify_signed_data_bytes
aprv_version
